cites.text: Resume is not a mode and grants nothing: it performs the `Next:` action of the latest `## Status` entry.
Spawn an executor only when the latest `## Status` grants the plan revision and work order about to run.
Never ask for a grant the log already records. A grant covers only the work orders it names: after their verdict, append a `## Status` and stop.
When a new run would start over a non-empty log whose latest `Next:` line is not `Next: none`, do not spawn the archive.

resume.next: perform Next: spawn squad-executor (STANDARD) for WO-1
refuse the archive: ask the user to resume, park, or abandon the open run
